constraint: Keep green glass dunes dominant. Architectural diversity and selective blue, coral, plum, gold and vermilion accents only. No changes to quests, temples or main characters. Kiln quarter and suspended dwellings rejected.

earlierApprovedDirections.title: Pearl labyrinth · broad galleries
earlierApprovedDirections.note: Broad raised galleries on slender columns, connected stairs and eroded scallops among roofless ruined shells.

earlierApprovedDirections.title: Pearl labyrinth · narrow lanes
earlierApprovedDirections.note: Empty stone shells with uneven broken tops, missing upper walls, open arches and a slender stopped clock above the galleries.

earlierApprovedDirections.title: Folded ravine
earlierApprovedDirections.note: Tall folded green sheets enclose a pale white-blue glass stair that climbs 112 m along the cliff; a lower arched bridge crosses the rift.

earlierApprovedDirections.title: City under the sand
earlierApprovedDirections.note: Close-set 46–58 m facades with offset floors, projecting rooms, emissive amber windows and overhead crossings beneath a 66 m green vault. The original exit and clock square remain.

earlierApprovedDirections.title: Prism cleft · arch crossing
earlierApprovedDirections.note: Sharp rectangular glass columns with inclined planar faces frame the high arch crossing.

earlierApprovedDirections.title: Prism cleft · crossing stairs
earlierApprovedDirections.note: Angular glass columns frame diagonal stairs, a lower branch and an upper bridge.
